text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her challenge in the Twinkle Series 
drawing near, Mejiro Ardan suddenly 
realized she was inside a dream reflecting 
memories of the past.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What unfolded was Mejiro Ardan's days of 
hardship from childhood to the present—the 
very foundation of who she is today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Awakening from her dream, Mejiro Ardan 
feels the beginning of her own history and 
approaches her training with renewed 
determination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her goal was to put everything she had 
into the race right before her "now," 
leaving a single trail of light behind in 
this world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to run her upcoming debut race 
with everything she has, the days of 
challenging herself alongside Mejiro Ardan 
began!
